Although Fićo and Nermin have different lives, life principles, and goals, both die and end up at -22.
filmSynopsis.longSynopsis: Nermin (30), an economist living in a modern, stylishly furnished apartment, gets ready and heads off to work. Before getting into his luxury car, he tosses aside a cigarette, which is picked up by Fićo (30) — a modest man who plays music on the street to earn his living. Although Fićo and Nermin lead very different lives, with different principles and goals, they both end up dying — and end up at -22°C.

data.title: Survival
filmProgrammes: 32nd SFF - BH Film - Documentary Feature Film

filmSynopsis.logline: Tokom 1201 dana opsade Bihaća, grupa muzičara predvođena Sejfom i bendom Okus Meda koristi muziku kao čin otpora, stvarajući pjesme nade koje su povezivale ljude tada — i koje i danas nose univerzalnu poruku zajedništva i ljubavi.
filmSynopsis.longSynopsis: SURVIVAL is an emotional documentary exploring the power of music during the siege of Bihać during the war of the 1990s. At the center of the story is Sejfo, frontman of the band Okus Meda, who together with a group of musicians and singers creates the song "Ljubav je svijet" ("Love Is the World") as a symbol of hope, resistance, and life in a time of fear and destruction. Through personal testimonies, archival footage, and the story of how the song came to be under siege, the film shows how music became a way of surviving, preserving identity, and preserving humanity. SURVIVAL is a powerful story of courage, togetherness, and art that was louder than war.

filmSynopsis.logline: Based on true events, Goran Stankovic’s Our Father portrays a recovering addict in an isolated Serbian monastery where not even God can save him from the extreme treatment methods of an authoritarian patriarch.
filmSynopsis.longSynopsis: When Dejan arrives at a monastery-based rehabilitation community for people struggling with addiction, he is welcomed by the charismatic Father Branko, who assigns him a mentor, Mionica, a former addict. Within a community governed by strict rules, harsh punishments, and brutal methods of treatment, Dejan quickly becomes Father Branko's favorite. But when footage exposing violence inside the community is leaked to the public, Dejan-now Branko's right-hand man-finds himself torn between loyalty to the man and the system that gave his life new purpose, and the demands of his own conscience.

filmSynopsis.logline: Four young friends from Belgrade drive from New York to Los Angeles in a Yugo, a cult relic of a car from the 1980s. A docu-comedy and a road trip with many unexpected encounters.
filmSynopsis.longSynopsis: Four millennials, born in the 1990s in the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, set off on a road trip across the United States in a Yugo, an old Yugoslav car once labelled “the worst car in the history of the USA.” Traveling through twenty-four states from New York City to Los Angeles, they search for an answer to the question: What does it mean to be the worst? Along the way, they meet people who were involved in importing the Yugo in the 1980s, present-day Yugo enthusiasts, Americans, and immigrants from post-Yugoslav countries. They also come face to face with their own personal history and the ways it is inseparable from the Yugo.

filmSynopsis.logline: When filmmaker Bojana Novakovic travels from Hollywood to rural Serbia to explore the life of the eccentric, tormented aunt she was never allowed to know, she is forced to face secrets about the women in her family and about herself as well. The result is a morbidly comedic, soap-operatic portrait of survival of four generations of Balkan women.
filmSynopsis.longSynopsis: In a world overflowing with soap operas, one Serbian family shows that reality is wilder, darker, and far more gripping than fiction. After a gut-wrenching breakup, Serbian-Australian actor-turned-filmmaker Bojana Novaković leaves the dazzling world of Hollywood and heads to rural Serbia, hoping to reconnect with her eccentric, estranged Aunt Gordana for some much-needed peace. What Bojana doesn’t anticipate, however, is the storm that will pull her into a whirlwind of family secrets, forcing her to confront the hidden trauma that’s shaped four generations of women in her family.

filmSynopsis.longSynopsis: 1977. Mario (16) lives in a small village in Ticino, Italian-speaking Switzerland. filmSynopsis.logline: A touching story about growing up between two worlds – and about the costs that come with tearing a family apart in the hope of finding happiness in another country.
filmSynopsis.longSynopsis: In 1991, amid the Balkan region's dissolution and prompted by the unfolding events, six-year-old Maja and her parents decide to journey from Yugoslavia to Denmark. Their encounter with the promised land proves to be a challenging ordeal for the small family, however, and particularly for Maja. She observes in wonder as her parents desperately try to adapt to an entirely new world. Witnessing her parents' difficulties, Maja quickly learns to speak Danish and consequently shoulders the responsibility of an adult to support them. Years later, despite achieving success, Maja grapples with conflicting emotions, recognising the sacrifices her parents made that shaped her life – for, as we know well, everything comes with its price.

Regional co-productions can take years to move from idea to greenlight. The Wedding went through seven years of financing and development before becoming the most-watched film in Croatian cinema history, with more than 2.4 million admissions in cinemas to date, as well as a major box-office success across the region. This case study examines what sustains a producer and director through such an extended development period, and what it takes for a small, deeply local story to find an audience on such a remarkable scale.
Bringing together director Igor Šeregi, producer Ivan Kelava, and actors Dragan Bjelogrlić and Rene Bitorajac, the conversation traces the film’s trajectory from its original idea in 2016 through years of development and financing to record-breaking box-office success and international distribution, a journey ten years in the making.
